description: This file exports a Python source code string embedded in a TypeScript module, which provides various functions for manipulating the filesystem via a sandboxed Python script. It is used to perform operations like directory traversal, file creation, removal, renaming, and write operations through subprocess calls.

methods.name: open_dir
methods.description: Open a directory with specific flags.

methods.name: walk_parent
methods.description: Traverse directory segments relative to a root file descriptor, creating directories if enabled.

methods.name: create_temp_file
methods.description: Create a temporary file with a unique name in a given directory.

methods.name: fd_path
methods.description: Get the filesystem path for a file descriptor, optionally appending a basename.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Run a subprocess command with specified file descriptors.

methods.name: write_stdin_to_fd
methods.description: Read data from stdin and write it to a file descriptor.

methods.name: run_write
methods.description: Handles writing data to a file in the sandboxed environment.

methods.name: run_mkdirp
methods.description: Create directories with parent directories if necessary.

methods.name: run_remove
methods.description: Remove files or directories, optionally recursively or forcefully.

methods.name: run_rename
methods.description: Rename or move files within sandboxed environment.
